Name: HERO_OPERATION_EXPLANATION_PARAM_ST
Description: Hints in each hero's operation guide: a hint text per hero and slot, replaced by its active hint while the player has the row's SpEffect.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on the rows of 6 of 10 heroes.

Fields.Name: Hero ID
Fields.Description: Hero (HeroParam row) whose controls guide shows this hint.

Fields.Name: Display Slot
Fields.Description: Page of the hero's controls guide that shows this hint: 0 passive ability, 1 character skill, 2 Ultimate Art. Each hero has one row per page.

Fields.Name: Hint Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text of the hint shown on this page.

Fields.Name: Alternate Hint SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: While the player has this SpEffect, the page shows Active Hint Text ID instead of Hint Text ID. -1: never. Retail: the "[Character Guide - <hero>] Skill Active" effects 603050-603090 (and 603071 Executor Ult Active).

Fields.Name: Active Hint Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text shown instead of Hint Text ID while the player has the Alternate Hint SpEffect. -1: none (both must be set). Retail: set on the Revenant, Recluse, Executor, Scholar and Undertaker skill rows and Executor's Ultimate Art row.
